metadata.short_desc: Management tools for AstrBot Skills and MCP servers
metadata.desc: Provides function tools and commands for managing AstrBot Skills and MCP servers, including skill lifecycle management, MCP server configuration management, and a built-in management skill.

skill_github_token.hint: Install from private repositories or increase API rate limits.

skill_review_language.hint: Choose the report language and its confirmation word.

skill_confirm_timeout.hint: Seconds to wait for the confirmation word; timeout cancels installation.

skill_review_provider_id.hint: Leave empty for the chat model; commands return the selected model's report directly.

skill_scan_mode.hint: AI tools: enforce blocks risks; report_only reports them.

diff_mode.hint: Edit MCP configuration with targeted replacements instead of full overwrites.

diff_match_threshold.hint: Text similarity required for replacements; 100 means an exact match.
